cohort: 3,253 singleton pregnant women enrolled in the Tongji Maternal and Child Health Cohort before 16 weeks of gestation
finding: While GDM was initially associated with decreased fetal growth measures and increased risk of cesarean section and preterm birth, these associations disappeared after adjusting for pre-pregnancy BMI and GWG; both pre-pregnancy BMI and GWG were independently associated with fetal growth and birth outcomes.
